title: Enforce corpus integrity: verify input hashes, typed splits, revision-bound replay (VC-201-001)
goal: VC-201-001 refuted: input_hash is never verified — a deserialized corpus carries tampered input+stale hash undetected (no validation API exists); split is a free-form string so a mislabeled held-out fixture escapes held_out() into the train side; replay_seeds ignores revision so 'replay the same revision' cannot be told from replaying another; and RsiCorpus has no production caller. Evidence: crates/susi-gawd/src/tests/vc_201_001_mastery.rs.
